WCAG 2.2 Level AA • ADA Title II • Revised Section 508

Accessibility & VPAT 2.5 Engineering

Accessibility shouldn't start only after an app is installed—users relying on screen readers, keyboard navigation, or Windows Contrast Themes have to get through the installer first. RaggieSoft Installer Studio engineers WCAG 2.2 AA and Revised Section 508 conformance directly into SetupWizard.exe and instbuild.exe.

Open Sample Live VPAT 2.5 Report (HTML5) Inspect C++20 Accessibility Source

How SetupWizard.exe Fixes Legacy Installer Accessibility Gaps

Full-Card Subclassed BS_AUTORADIOBUTTON Targets

Instead of tiny unlabeled radio dots paired with non-focusable graphic labels, every setup option card is a true Win32 BS_AUTORADIOBUTTON (≥ 68px tall, exceeding WCAG 2.5.8) exposing native UI Automation RadioButton roles and full descriptions to Narrator, NVDA, and JAWS.

High-Contrast Focus Rings & Enforced Mnemonics

Draws unmistakable 2.5px keyboard focus rings (12.6:1 in Dark Mode, 7.8:1 in Light Mode, exceeding WCAG 2.4.11/2.4.13) and statically verifies & keyboard mnemonics via instbuild --validate.

Windows Contrast Themes & Per-Monitor V2 DPI

Honors SPI_GETHIGHCONTRAST using pure OS GetSysColor tokens, themes RichEdit license text for ≥ 15:1 contrast in Dark & Light Mode, and scales cleanly with Windows 11's TextScaleFactor.
